text:
jordan-peopleops: Quick heads up 1900012345 1: new hire Ashley M starts 6/7 remote. Background flagged 'name variation' and BG vendor wants a short notarized statement. Passport arrival delayed. Need to decide I-9 path and laptop ship.

paul-recruiter: She prefers remote start and can't make the office first week. She said she can do a same-day notarization with a local notary and upload the PDF.

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK: Ashley M 1900012500 status: manual review. Additional doc requested: notarized name-affidavit or certified marriage certificate. Doc request sent 1900012600.

jordan-peopleops: Policy reminder: remote hires can complete I-9 via authorized agent OR employer can accept a notarized affidavit + gov ID within 3 business days. We need to document the exception in Workday (I-9 exception form).

it-ops: Shipping policy: default is ship T+1. If BG flagged, we put "HOLD" on device. If candidate uploads notarized docs before ship cutoff (5pm PT), we can release same day. Otherwise hold. If they need a device immediately, we can do concierge pickup with ID.

jordan-peopleops: I'll send Ashley an email asking for: 1) upload of notarized affidavit + gov ID to secure link, 2) whether she can meet an authorized agent (we reimburse up to $75), 3) confirm shipping address and if she wants concierge pickup. Draft below.

paul-recruiter: Please add benefit enrollment note: new hires have 30 days to enroll; remind about 401k deferral and the performance onboarding doc they need to read. Also add a line about data privacy acknowledgment.

jordan-peopleops: Draft email: 
"Hi Ashley, welcome! A few quick items so we can finish your background and I-9:
1) Upload a photo of your government ID (passport or driver\u2019s license) and a notarized name-affidavit (if applicable) to https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire
2) If you can use an authorized agent instead, reply with availability and we can book & reimburse up to $75
3) Do you want your laptop shipped (signature required) or will you pick up at concierge? We will hold shipment until ID verified unless you confirm docs uploaded by 5pm PT
4) Enroll in benefits within 30 days of your start date or you will be auto-enrolled in base plan.
Thanks, Jordan (People Ops)"

newhire-ashley: Thanks Jordan 1900012630 I can get a notarized affidavit tomorrow and will upload it. Please ship to my home and hold if BG still open. I prefer courier with signature. Also, I asked about the performance onboarding doc  where do I find it?

it-ops: Got it. We'll set shipment to "HOLD" and mark signature-required. Once BG closes, we switch to ship and send tracking.

jordan-peopleops: Performance checklist link: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/performance-onboarding-checklist. I'll also assign a buddy and invite to the pre-start sync.

bg-check-bot: Docs received 1900012700. Reviewer notes: affidavit uploaded, govt ID present. Reviewer assigned 1900012750.

jordan-peopleops: Perfect. I'll update Workday with the I-9 exception form and release laptop once BG finalizes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
